headline: Where to find Paloxite in Palworld
title: Where to Find Paloxite | World Tree Ore | Palworld Guide
video_script: Paloxite is a pink glowing ore found in the World Tree in Palworld one point zero. The catch is that its nodes vanish when you walk up to them. Drink World Tree Holy Water first, and give some to your active Pal too, then mine fast with the Plasma Multicutter. One good trio of nodes sits near Dusty Ravine, around minus fifteen sixty, fifteen ten. Holy Water drops from World Tree Pals. Have you farmed Paloxite yet? Comment below!
description: Palworld 1.0 Paloxite guide: find it in the World Tree, use Holy Water so nodes stop vanishing, and mine with the Plasma Multicutter.
